raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted a straightforward question (“What pantheon is the Egyptian god of the underworld part of?”) by shifting the goal from identifying the Egyptian pantheon (or the Heliopolitan Ennead) to asserting a “Memphite” pantheon affiliation via the Ptah-Sokar-Osiris triad. This conflated a local theological syncretism with the notion of pantheon, led to task drift, and triggered repetitive, unproductive WebSurfer searches to validate an irrelevant angle, instead of synthesizing the simple, correct answer.
